findings.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
findings.body_summary: Offline sync passes masked redactedTokenRef to fieldCheckInService.consume, so recovered offline scans cannot pass QR token verification.
findings.claim: Offline sync must preserve a verifiable QR token for server consume instead of sending only tok_... masked text.
evidence: Before fix, apps/api/src/modules/field-operations/offline-sync.service.ts line 94 passed attempt.redactedTokenRef as consume token.
apps/web/app/field/check-in/page.tsx createPendingAttempt produced only redactedTokenRef from redactedTokenRef(token), so the sync payload had no verifiable token.
packages/shared/src/schemas/field-operations.schema.ts now requires FieldOfflineSyncAttempt.token, and apps/api/src/modules/field-operations/offline-sync.service.ts now consumes attempt.token.
apps/api/src/modules/field-operations/offline-sync.service.spec.ts now asserts fieldCheckInService.consume receives RAW_QR_TOKEN while result/audit outputs remain redacted.

fix.summary: Added a verifiable token field to offline sync attempts, persisted it in the browser pending queue, sent it in sync requests, and used it for server consume.

findings.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
findings.body_summary: Field monitor scan log query limits to 100 rows without deterministic ordering.
findings.claim: Scan logs should be ordered before applying limit(100), otherwise current abnormal events may be omitted from the operations screen.
evidence: Before fix, apps/api/src/modules/field-operations/field-monitor.service.ts ended the scan log query with .where(...).limit(100) and no orderBy.
Current code imports desc from drizzle-orm and applies .orderBy(desc(ticketScanEvents.scannedAt), desc(ticketScanEvents.id)) before .limit(100).
apps/api/src/modules/field-operations/field-monitor.service.spec.ts now records query builder calls and asserts orderBy appears before limit.

fix.summary: Ordered field monitor scan logs by newest scan timestamp and stable id tie-breaker before limiting to 100 rows.
